text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: p99 streaming stall spike detected in eu-west-1 for SSE/Websocket paths. Affected svc: /v1/stream (redwood-edge-proxy). Rate of stalled connections up 6x in last 5m. auto-page: oncall@redwood

 eve_oncall: seeing it, joining. p95 also creeping. customer reports of truncated streams + reconnects. tagging eng-sre and eng-runtime.

 alice_sre: on it. first-pass: looks like proxy write latency spikes + connection resets. Noticing high `proxy_wait` counts on edge nodes.

 bob_runtime: I can repro locally with high fanout client that slows reading -> backend KV cache fill. Stack: envoy+lua -> edge-proxy -> runtime. Any recent config pushes?

dan_platform: rolled a small proxy change 2h ago to tweak keepalive behavior in eu-west canary. Rollout at 10:12 UTC. Rolling back now to test.

 carla_support: customer A (acme-inc) opened a ticket: "stream stops after ~12s, then client gets empty chunk". They've got streaming UX impacted on web.

 frank_csm: prioritized. Customer A on standby; need ETA for mitigation.

 alice_sre: mitigation plan: 1) pause proxy rollout 2) revert keepalive change in eu-west 3) enable short-term `proxy_buffering off` for streaming routes 4) evict slow consumers via slow-client-eject flag 5) enable fallback polling for critical customers.

 bob_runtime: adding diagnostics: `ss -ntp | grep ESTAB` on edge to count half-open, `nginx -T | grep proxy_buffering` to confirm. Capturing tcpdump for a sample stream: `tcpdump -i ens5 -w /tmp/stream-sample.pcap port 443 and host CUSTOMER_IP`

 eve_oncall: executing reverts + toggle now. Dan, can you confirm rollback succeeded on the canary?

 dan_platform: rollback started. canary nodes at 10:34 UTC. 3/3 canary nodes back to previous config, diff shows keepalive back to 75s.

 alice_sre: toggled `proxy_buffering off` for route /v1/stream on edge-proxy eu-west. This will disable buffering and flush chunks as they arrive. Expect initial improvement within a minute.

 bob_runtime: also enabling slow-client-eject at 30s threshold on the runtime side to prevent head-of-line blocking. Command: `redwoodctl set runtime --slow-client-eject 30s --zone eu-west-1`

 carla_support: already pinged Customer A to enable fallback polling (they accepted). Will update if they see improvement.

 eve_oncall: monitoring p95/p99 on grafana panel. adding a short dashboard share: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/streaming/stream-slo?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west-1

 IncidentBot: UPDATE: anomaly mitigations applied (proxy buffer off, canary rollback, slow-client-eject). Alert will be suppressed for 10m while we observe.

 alice_sre: early signals: p99 dropped ~40% in first 2m; number of stalled connections halved. Still seeing intermittent client backpressure spikes from a subset of origin clients (long-poll mobile).

 bob_runtime: captured logs from runtime: `WARN: client-read-timeout: 34000ms; write backpressure` — looks like some clients are applying poor TCP windowing. We should add metrics to track per-connection rcv-window and apply a more conservative batching window on runtime.

 dan_platform: rolling a targeted proxy config to increase `proxy_send_timeout` from 60s -> 90s for streaming routes to avoid premature timeouts while we tune. Will push to eu-west in ~10m with canary.

 carla_support: Customer A reports streams resumed, though they see occasional micro-freezes. They can tolerate until we complete cleanup. :white_check_mark:

 frank_csm: pinging other customers in impacted list, will gather any additional reports.

 eve_oncall: handoff plan: I'll stay on this for another 30m to verify stability, then hand to day-shift (alice). If p99 remains >2x baseline we'll escalate to incident bridge.

 alice_sre: follow-ups: - add per-edge connection age histogram - instrument proxy for `write-backpressure-ms` - postmortem draft after stabilization - notify customers about temporary config changes.

 bob_runtime: quick patch idea: if client read-slow detected, fork a light-weight fallthrough worker that streams small chunks more frequently (`chunk_size=256B`, `flush_interval=50ms`) to avoid proxy buffer amplification. I'll prototype.

 IncidentBot: NOTE: created incident ticket #INC-2026, assigned to alice_sre. Priority: P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026

 eve_oncall: thanks team. continuing monitor. tagging @carla_support and @frank_csm for customer updates. If anything regresses call oncall.

 carla_support: will collate logs from Customer A and a second customer (beta-streams) and attach to the INC-2026 ticket.

 alice_sre: drafting a short status to send to affected customers in 30m. Will include root-cause hypothesis: proxy keepalive + client backpressure interaction causing head-of-line stalls and buffer amplification.

 bob_runtime: test notes: load test with slow-reader clients replicates the p99 spike locally. Pushing test harness to repo: `git push origin streaming-slow-read-test`

 eve_oncall: last check (10:58 UTC): metrics stable, p99 down to ~1.3x baseline. leaving note in channel. I'll update INC ticket and then hand over per plan at 11:10 UTC.

 frank_csm: thanks all, will keep customers updated.

 carla_support: closing customer-facing interim note. :)

 alice_sre: handover ack. next: follow-up postmortem and longer-term fixes (proxy tuning, slow-client detection, runtime chunk strategy).

 IncidentBot: RESOLVED ALERT: anomaly status cleared for eu-west-1 streaming paths. Auto-close window started.

 eve_oncall: end of thread — handing to alice for postmortem and follow-ups. Good work. :thumbsup:
